items.headline: GPT-6 Astra-found "Chair44" claimed as first 3D aperiodic monotile
items.summary: Software developer Ioannis Tsiokos posted a 61-page, AI-written paper claiming that a single 3D tile, Chair44, tiles space only non-periodically. He said GPT-6 Astra found it. The finite checks were run by machine and partly formalized in Lean. Chaim Goodman-Strauss, co-discoverer of the 2D "hat" tile, condensed the core argument into an 8-page paper and praised the discovery, but said the original paper and its formalization are not readily checkable.
